pages.title: sweetspot_architecture_v1
pages.description: Create a landscape scientific framework diagram for seven-target sweetspot prediction. Do not add an overall title. LEFT DOMAIN ANCHOR: three compact evidence families—static geology, petrophysical well logs, and causal production histories with past-only covariates. CENTRAL VISUAL CORE: a large seven-target evidence router T1 through T7 that prevents any synthetic composite sweetspot score. COOL-BLUE CONFIRMED LANES: T1 LightGBM regression, T2 CatBoost classification, T4 CatBoost classification. For T3, show both the archived XGBoost control and a dominant WARM-ORANGE Chronos-2 branch. Expand Chronos-2 internally as grouped target/covariate tokens, group attention transformer cube stacks, and a forecast horizon. Blend the Chronos-2 forecast with the fold-train causal history mean using y_hat_T3 = alpha y_hat_Chronos2 ⊕ (1-alpha) mu_train, and color this lane green after the development promotion gate. GREY STATUS LANES: T5 not feasible, T6 blocked, T7 blocked; show stopped arrows, not predictions. RIGHT OUTPUT: four legitimate target-specific outputs and three explicit status cards. Add a compact router formula y_hat_t = f_{R(t)}(E_t), where E_t denotes only evidence legal for target t. BOTTOM TRAINING STRIP: target-specific grouped development folds -> train-only preprocessing -> fixed-budget model comparison -> T3 causal rolling-origin folds and fold-train blend selection -> dual-baseline promotion gate -> known-holdout confirmation without feedback. Label time-series tensors Y_past in R^(B×T×1), C_past in R^(B×T×6), and forecast in R^(B×H). No metric values, no long text, no table.
